correctness.rationale: The Binet substitution gives the exact identity \(S_n=1024t^2F(t)\) with \(t=(17-12\sqrt2)^n\) and \(F(t)=\sum_{j\ge0}\rho^{2j}(1-t\rho^j)^{-4}\). Expanding \(F\) by the binomial theorem and inverting its analytic power series gives exact coefficients. Direct Binet expansions for \(B_n^4-B_{n-1}^4\) and \(B_{2n-1}\) show that the \(t^{-1}\) coefficient vanishes exactly only at \(c=1/280\). The constant and first correction then follow by coefficient subtraction. `verify.py` independently reconstructs these coefficients in \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\).
risks: The finite direct-tail computations do not prove the infinite claim; they are explicitly nonessential. The proof relies instead on local analyticity and exact coefficient identities.
